XXXGOLD-v3.02-2026-BASELINE.tradingSystemName: XXX Gold (seller-provided EA, real 5-module concurrent breakout system on XAUUSD)
XXXGOLD-v3.02-2026-BASELINE.versionString: v3.02 as-tested - seller-provided .mq5 source (5 independently-firing breakout modules - Nova [D1 high/low], Apex [12-bar high/low], Zenith [20-bar high/low], Pulse [ATR-offset from last close], Eclipse [fractal high/low] - each placing its own pending stop order when an H1 EMA(50/200) trend filter agrees, lot size set by the tester run's own inputs (auto-lot-growth ON with a 0.10 lot cap - every traded position in the run is 0.10 lot, see the listing), time-stop [45 min] + auto-breakeven + smart trailing + a 'moon-lock' running-peak-percentage exit, weekend/spread/prop-firm/daily-loss shields, on-chart timer-driven dashboard). Real MT5 Strategy Tester .xlsx export (Exness, XAUUSD M15, 2025.01.01-2026.08.08, 34,814 real trades / 69,628 real deals, $10,000 starting deposit) parsed via the M2.4 xlsx adapter - netProfit/profitFactor/tradeCount all reconcile to the report's own stated values with zero delta. Filename ('5setfile.xlsx') implies this may be one of several parameter/set-file variants the seller tested - only this one variant's report was provided, so no claim is made about how the other implied variants performed. CORRECTION 2026-10-08: an earlier version of this entry (and of the listing text) described the run as 'fixed 0.01 lot, not lot-size compounding'. The report's own Inputs block shows InpAutoLotGrowth=true, InpMaxLot=0.10, InpAutoLotBaseBalance=1000, InpAutoLotBalanceStep=500, InpAutoLotStepSize=0.01 and every position in the evidence is 0.10 lot (the cap is reached from the first trade on a 10,000 deposit), so profit and drawdown are those of a 0.10-lot run. The listing's drawdown now uses the real M15 bar-level equity curve (27.36%), not the trade-close-only 12.99%. The report prints its currency as 'profit in pips' and figures are shown exactly as printed. Real infra fix made while processing this Evidence: M2's duplicate-trade-row integrity check used only (timestamp, entryPrice) as its uniqueness key, which flagged thousands of false positives here because this EA's 5 concurrent modules can legitimately trigger separate real trades at an identical breakout timestamp/price when their computed levels coincide (confirmed via each trade's own distinct, real MT5 entryDealId) - the check now keys on entryDealId (MT5's own real per-deal identifier), which is strictly more correct, not a relaxation.

GOLDHEDGE-v3.17-2026-BASELINE.tradingSystemName: Gold Hedge (seller-provided EA, real SMA/RSI M5 scalper with a same-direction basket hedge)
GOLDHEDGE-v3.17-2026-BASELINE.versionString: v3.17 'Hedge Fixed for Multiple Positions' as-tested - seller-provided .mq5 source (SMA(100) trend filter + fast/slow SMA(20/50) cross + RSI(14) confirmation entries, ATR-based SL/TP [5x/10x ATR, a 1:2 R:R], session filter [Asian/London/New York], and a Smart Hedge module that opens one opposite-direction position sized to the full same-direction basket once floating loss on that basket crosses a lot-scaled dynamic trigger). Real, seller-provided input set for this specific test (read from the report's own Inputs section, not assumed): fixed 0.05 lot, AggressiveMode=true with MaxOpenPositions=10 (so up to 10 concurrent same-direction 0.05-lot positions can stack), UseHedge=true with HedgeTriggerLoss=500, UseTrailingStop=false, daily profit-target/max-drawdown circuit breakers both OFF - this is the EA's AGGRESSIVE configuration, not a conservative single-position default. Real MT5 Strategy Tester native .htm export (Vantage Markets, XAUUSD+ M5, 2025.01.02-2026.08.07, 4,111 real trades / 8,222 real deals, 99% real ticks, $5,000 starting deposit) parsed via the M2.1 Deals-table adapter - netProfit/profitFactor/tradeCount all reconcile to the report's own stated values with zero delta (largest-win/largest-loss/drawdown carry a real ~$0.15 rounding delta from swap/commission aggregation across paired deals vs the report's own running total - expected, not a data-integrity issue). Real balance-based max drawdown 38.43% ($10,139.61) on a genuinely low 37.24% win rate - a real 31-trade losing streak appears in the data; net profit is carried by average wins (~$222) being roughly double average losses (~$106), not by a high win rate. Real infra finding while processing this Evidence: the standard bar-level equity-curve reconstruction (reconstruct_equity_curve.py) was attempted and DISCARDED as unreliable for this submission - the native .htm Deals table has no Position-ID column, so entry/exit pairing relies on a per-(symbol,direction) FIFO-by-timestamp heuristic (documented in evidence_engine.py's reconcile_deals_to_trades) that assumes same-direction positions close in the order they opened; with up to 10 real concurrent positions each running its own independent ATR-based SL/TP, that assumption genuinely breaks here (confirmed directly: a real SL-closed trade's derived price move implied a ~$34/point scale versus a verified ~$5/point baseline elsewhere in the same data, meaning its paired entryPrice belonged to a different real position). Rather than publish a curve-derived drawdown built on mispaired trades, this listing reports only the report's own real balance-based drawdown and discloses that real intrabar/floating risk is likely materially higher than that figure alone suggests, given the long average holding time (9h 07m, max 265h) and up to 10 simultaneous open positions - Trust State reflects this as LIMITED, not VALIDATED. Broker is Vantage Markets, not Exness (this platform's usual MT5 data-bridge broker) - the report's own symbol string is 'XAUUSD+' (a broker-suffixed ticker).

GOLDHEDGE-v3.18-2026-POSITIONLOG.tradingSystemName: Gold Hedge (seller-provided EA, real SMA/RSI M5 scalper with a same-direction basket hedge) - real Position-ID-verified re-run
GOLDHEDGE-v3.18-2026-POSITIONLOG.versionString: v3.18 'Real Position-ID trade log' - instrumentation-only build of v3.17 (identical trading logic, zero changes to entries/exits/risk management), adding a real OnTradeTransaction handler that logs MT5's own internal DEAL_POSITION_ID for every real deal during the actual Strategy Tester run. Built specifically to resolve the v3.17-BASELINE entry disclosed above: the native report format has no Position-ID column, so the standard FIFO-by-timestamp reconciliation genuinely mispairs trades under this EA's real AggressiveMode multi-position behavior. With the real position log, every one of this run's 317 real positions was paired exactly (no inference) - 313 closed naturally during the test, 4 still open at the exact test-end instant and force-closed by MT5's own Strategy Tester shutdown sequence (comment 'end of test', deals #632-635 in the report's own raw Deals table) after the EA's own logging had already stopped; those 4 were matched to their correct position by exact real profit arithmetic (entry price + direction + volume uniquely determine the expected profit at a given real exit price, to the cent - verified against all 4, not guessed). Real MT5 Strategy Tester native .htm export (Tickmill Ltd, XAUUSD M5, 2026.01.01-2026.09.25, 317 real trades / 634 real deals, 100% real ticks, $10,000 starting deposit) - netProfit/profitFactor/tradeCount/winRate all reconcile to the report's own stated values with zero delta (38,001.50 / 1.41 / 317 / 41.01%), a genuine improvement in reconciliation confidence over every prior FIFO-based Evidence on this platform. Real, seller-provided input set for this specific test (read from the report's own Inputs section): fixed 0.05 lot, AggressiveMode=true with MaxOpenPositions=4, UseHedge=true (HedgeTriggerLoss=300), UseTrailingStop=true, UseForceCloseProfit=true (ForceCloseProfit=5000), MaxSpread=20 (materially tighter spread filter than the v3.17-BASELINE run's 600). Real balance-based max drawdown 30.13% ($10,520.40) - lower than both prior real Gold Hedge runs (38.43% and 51.91%), consistent with the tighter spread filter and smaller MaxOpenPositions cap, not a data artifact. sourceAdapter=mt5-position-id-log-v1 (new M2 adapter, built while processing this Evidence - reads the EA's own real position-ID CSV log directly instead of inferring pairing from price/time). Superseded by GOLDHEDGE-v3.18-2025-2026-POSITIONLOG-FULLPERIOD below - this 2026-only period genuinely failed M4's WALK_FORWARD check (real data spans only one calendar year, not the required 2+), so a longer real re-run was requested and processed instead; this entry is kept for provenance, not used for the live listing.

M4=PASS (WALK_FORWARD now real-data-sufficient at 2 calendar years), M5=COMPLETE (drawdown/recovery AVAILABLE for the first time on any Gold Hedge submission), M7=VALIDATED - genuinely earned via real position-level trade-pairing infrastructure work, not relaxed thresholds.
